campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council agenda for September 15, 2026 includes a proposed update to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for a resurfacing project, an annual update to the city's investment policy, and a budget adjustment related to a replacement project.
keyTopics: Proposed modification to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy), effective September 16th
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for a resurfacing project
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining (item details cut off in source)

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's agenda for September 16, 2026 includes routine items like meeting minutes and vendor payments, plus two appeals of Planning Commission decisions on housing development projects. The agenda also lists a discussion of law enforcement service options for the city ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of a Design Review and setback variance for a home and ADU at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of a three-lot subdivision approval (Tentative Map, Design Review) at 14486 Oak Place
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Law enforcement service options discussion ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council agenda for September 22, 2026 included routine items like approving prior meeting minutes and a wastewater treatment plant agreement, along with an interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on detention or custodial facility applications. The agenda also listed commission appointments, a legal services contract amendment, and extending a councilmember's regional transit board role.
keyTopics: Interim urgency ordinance proposing a temporary moratorium on applications for detention or custodial facilities and custodial-processing facilities
Resolution to authorize Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant Basic Agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Appointment of Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg to an additional two-year term on the VTA Board representing north counties
Appointments to the Complete Streets Commission, Environmental Commission, and Planning Commission
Amendment No. 1 to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating the monthly retainer to $21,500 for up to 70 hours plus a $385 hourly rate

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: This Los Gatos Town Council agenda covers routine business, including approval of minutes from prior closed and open session meetings and a monthly financial report for July 2026. It also includes several contract-related items, such as amendments to service agreements and a heating/ventilation/air conditioning contract, plus authorizations for new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Closed Session and regular Town Council meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026, including a correction
Second amendment to an existing agreement authorized for the Town Manager to execute
First amendment to a Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) services agreement
New professional services agreements authorized for the Town Manager to execute

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 30, 2026
san-jose.summary: This San José Rules and Open Government Committee agenda covers routine business, including finalizing the October 6, 2026 Council agenda and noting the October 13 meeting is cancelled. It also lists several special event approvals, a joint meeting with the Treatment Plant Advisory Committee, and multiple proposed policy items on council transparency and automated license plate reader oversight.
keyTopics: Approval of special events including a Mulcahy-sponsored 'Conversations for Good 2026' event, a District 9 farewell celebration, and retroactive approval of a Golden State Valkyries flag raising event
Proposed items on Council Transparency and Private Non-Disclosure Agreements
Two related proposals on Automated License Plate Reader data access, internal controls, and safeguards
Joint Special Meeting agenda with the San José/Santa Clara Treatment Plant Advisory Committee
Update to the August-December 2026 Public Safety, Finance and Strategic Support Committee Work Plan

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee — September 29, 2026
mountain-view.summary: This Mountain View Council Sustainability Committee agenda covers the city's draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan and the 2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory. It also includes time for public comment and committee/staff discussion.
keyTopics: Draft Five-Year Community Decarbonization Plan
2024 Community Greenhouse Gas Emissions Inventory

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 29, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council's agenda for September 29, 2026 includes several contracts and upgrades—including recreation software, video conferencing equipment, power supply systems, and a maintenance management system—plus a reimbursement agreement with VTA for water facility relocation tied to the US 101 Express Lanes project. The agenda also lists adoption of the city's five-year Homelessness Response Plan and positions on state and local ballot measures for the November 2026 election.
keyTopics: Adoption of the Sunnyvale Homelessness Response Plan as a five-year framework, with a community outreach update
Contract awards for City Hall video conferencing equipment, Traffic Management Center upgrades, UPS systems upgrades, and a Computerized Maintenance Management System
Reimbursement agreement with VTA for relocating city water facilities for the US 101 Express Lanes project, with a $300,000 budget modification
Side letter agreement with the Public Safety Officers Association adding special assignment pay for a new Community Crime Reduction Team
Adoption of city positions on state and local ballot measures for the November 3, 2026 election

cupertino.title: Cupertino Parks and Recreation Commission — October 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The October 1 agenda for Cupertino's Parks and Recreation Commission listed an item from the Parks and Recreation Department's Youth/Teen/Events/Facilities Division, approval of September 3 meeting minutes, and future agenda setting.
keyTopics: Parks and Recreation Department Youth/Teen/Events/Facilities Division
Approval of September 3, 2026 Parks and Recreation Commission meeting minutes
Upcoming draft agenda items

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council's agenda includes a public hearing on a proposed 408-unit housing development at 451-475 El Camino Real, covering annexation, rezoning, and a subdivision map, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under state environmental law (CEQA). The council was also scheduled to meet in closed session to discuss ongoing and potential litigation, including a case involving the city's electric utility.
keyTopics: Public hearing on prezoning, annexation, and a vesting tentative subdivision map to allow 408 residential units at 451-475 El Camino Real, supported by an Environmental Impact Report under CEQA
Closed session on existing litigation: City of Santa Clara (Silicon Valley Power) and Northern California Power Agency vs. California Department of Water Resources
Closed session on anticipated litigation involving one potential case

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council agenda for September 15, 2026 covers federal housing grant funding, a review of the city's red light camera traffic safety program, and the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The agenda also includes financial actions related to the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency, including a bond refunding resolution.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Community Center
Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency board
Resolution for the sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission — September 22, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Parks and Recreation Commission's agenda for this meeting includes a council liaison report, a staff department update, and committee/liaison updates. The main substantive items are a review of proposed guidelines for synthetic turf use on playgrounds and a park improvements ordinance recommendation tied to the Foothills Nature Preserve improvement project.
keyTopics: Review of proposed playground synthetic turf use guidelines
Park Improvements Ordinance recommendation for the Foothills Nature Preserve Improvement Project (PE-21000)
Department report and staff presentation
Ad hoc committees and liaison updates discussion
